description: Midnights?? mother said 'I'm staying up past 3am thinking about every man who wronged me and turning it into bops' and I have never felt more seen 😭✨ 'Anti-Hero' and 'Karma' are the anthems of my entire existence. The whole album is unhinged, glittery self-loathing and I am OBSESSED with the lore. It's messy in the best way, no skips, blondie ate and left no crumbs 💅🔥
